scenes.caption: A butterfly's story.
scenes.say: First, a butterfly. It starts as a tiny egg on a leaf.

scenes.caption: Larva and pupa.
scenes.say: A caterpillar hatches and eats leaves. Then it makes a pupa, and changes inside.

scenes.caption: A butterfly!
scenes.say: An adult butterfly comes out. It is the same animal, but changed.

scenes.caption: A frog's story.
scenes.say: Next, a frog. Frogspawn in the pond hatches into tadpoles.

scenes.caption: Legs and lungs.
scenes.say: The tadpole grows legs and lungs. It becomes a froglet, then a frog.

scenes.caption: A hen's story.
scenes.say: A hen lays an egg and sits on it. After three weeks, a chick hatches.

scenes.caption: A lamb's story.
scenes.say: A lamb is born alive. It drinks milk and grows into a sheep.

scenes.caption: Protect them.
scenes.say: Safe habitats help all young animals grow. We can help them too!
